scenarios.cut: after durable check job commit before discovery
scenarios.prove: restart recovers/retries job; no ImportRun/domain mutation is fabricated

scenarios.cut: after ImportRun validating creation before any row
scenarios.prove: run remains unpublished; restart may fail/restart it; no source presence/checkpoint mutation
partial rows excluded from review/domain/replay authority; restart never marks them complete without EOF/fingerprint/count verification
run still validating; no proposals/source authority/checkpoint; deterministic republish/reparse safe
cleanup+terminal transition failure leaves validating/no domain history; retry can safely clean/reparse; no duplicate published observations survive

scenarios.cut: after newer-identical run enters noop_pending_checkpoint before checkpoint command
scenarios.prove: domain unchanged; restart identifies pending technical checkpoint update; idempotent command advances checkpoint once then run noop

scenarios.cut: during newer-identical checkpoint update before run noop
scenarios.prove: checkpoint and run transition share one UoW and both roll back; no checkpoint/run disagreement

scenarios.cut: after new source observations published before proposal acceptance
scenarios.prove: source presence/history survives restart; no target mutation has occurred; pending proposals remain reviewable

scenarios.cut: inside proposal acceptance after owning RFC/WFM mutation but before accepted disposition
scenarios.prove: same UoW rolls back owner mutation, receipt/audit and disposition; proposal stays pending

scenarios.cut: inside terminal RFC acceptance after terminal projection but before LLD-03 pending cascade rows
scenarios.prove: LLD-03 same-UoW contract rolls back terminal projection; never terminal-without-required-proposal

scenarios.cut: cross-domain mutation service attempts nested commit
scenarios.prove: test double/framework rejects nested commit; outer UnitOfWork remains sole transaction authority

scenarios.race: target revision/base token changes after proposal review before accept
scenarios.prove: IMPORT_PROPOSAL_STALE; no accepted disposition/domain mutation; old proposal evidence retained

scenarios.race: Customer reference generation changes between candidate proposal and accept
scenarios.prove: base token changes, stale acceptance blocked; ambiguity never guessed

scenarios.race: RFC hierarchy changes after subordinate-origin SR link proposal
scenarios.prove: LLD-03 governing-root revalidation rejects stale target; no direct subordinate link fabricated

scenarios.race: Task plan/execution lock changes before WFM plan proposal accept
scenarios.prove: LLD-05 base token rejects stale source-plan consequence; source observation remains intact

scenarios.cut: run finalization after run state calculation before checkpoint write
scenarios.prove: run final state/checkpoint/audit share one UoW; rollback leaves run review state unchanged and checkpoint old

scenarios.cut: equal-chronology recovery after domain corrections before recovery event/checkpoint replacement
scenarios.prove: recovery completion contract fails closed; checkpoint not silently replaced; commands are idempotently resumable from recorded per-proposal dispositions
accepted correction evidence may survive per-target commits but final recovery event is appended exactly once; source checkpoint chronology never decreases

scenarios.cut: one target in multi-selection accept fails
scenarios.prove: each independently safe proposal has its own atomic result; failed target does not roll back already committed unrelated target and UI reports every target; no silent skip

scenarios.race: a formerly equivalent rejected proposal becomes materially different
scenarios.prove: material-input fingerprint differs so suppression no longer applies; new current-state proposal may be reviewed while old rejection remains immutable

scenarios.cut: inside PublishStagedImportRun after authoritative publication writes but before ticket_import.sr_reappearance_reconcile enqueue/commit
scenarios.prove: the one publication UoW rolls back run publication/evidence/proposals/receipt/audit and durable-job enqueue together; no failed/unpublished evidence can clear an LLD-03 disappearance warning

scenarios.cut: inside one sr_reappearance_reconcile per-SR internal command after outer receipt or LLD-03 event insert but before audit/result/commit
scenarios.prove: that command rolls back receipt/event/audit/result atomically; durable job checkpoint does not advance past the failed SR; restart retries safely and exact command replay prevents duplicate reappearance events
